newsitem.title: UK: Whessoe shares gain on fresh bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Whessoe shares gain on fresh bid approach.

text.p: Shares in Whessoe Plc rose on Wednesday as Norway's Seatex ASA and Swiss Endress+Hauser trumped Siebe Plc's 46 million stg bid with a cash offer worth 52.6 million stg or 175p per share.
Whessoe shares closed 26-1/2p higher at 183-1/2p, a premium to the latest bid, in active trade of 3.3 million shares. Siebe fell 11p to 964-1/2.
A spokesman for Siebe said the company would make a formal response in due course. Analysts said there was good chance Siebe would come back with a higher offer.
"The original price was very cheap," said Chris Hemingway at Lehman Brothers.

"It looked expensive on the basis of Whessoe's earnings but given Siebe's track record in turning businesses around, they were bidding at around five times restructured operating earnings where others in the sector are trading at a multiple of ten times."
